verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review docs confirm a 'Custom rules' feature letting teams define explicit natural-language guidelines for the review agent, plus 'comment exclusions' to tune behavior, which covers the natural-language rules part of the story. However, there is no evidence of AST-pattern-based rule definition or linking external/style-guide documents for enforcement. Missing for 10: AST pattern rule support, ability to link external style guides, and independent/hands-on confirmation that custom rules are reliably enforced.
